title: Dual-external reversible preflight and publication ordering
central_question: Can the joint SWAP candidate, a prepared MODFLOW solve and a Ribasim realization be orchestrated so that any surface-transfer mismatch or groundwater nonconvergence is resolved before either external model crosses an irreversible publication point?
invariants: No MODFLOW finalize_time_step before joint SWAP publication_ready is true.
No persistent Ribasim accepted-state publication before joint SWAP publication_ready is true.
A Ribasim realized-transfer mismatch discards the SWAP candidate and recomposes from the same accepted SWAP, MODFLOW and Ribasim origins.
A MODFLOW residual failure discards the SWAP candidate and does not publish Ribasim acceptance.
Exactly one external publication sequence occurs per accepted window.
The SWAP commit occurs exactly once and only after both external preflights are green.
required_cases: C1 all receipts match and convergence is green: publish once
C2 Ribasim mismatch first: no external publication, recomposition, then publish once
C3 groundwater not converged: no publication
C4 stale joint SWAP origin: no publication
implementation_scope: Research orchestration policy with deterministic external transaction doubles first. Live product integration follows only after ordering is proven.
